blocks.html: In the third place, the said de Rols, who has so virtuously prosecuted the said accused, when she was confronted with the said du Tilh the prisoner (who was willing to believe her upon her oath, submitting himself to a thousand cruel deaths if she swore that he was not Martin Guerre her husband), never dared to swear; but said, bluntly enough, that she would not swear, nor believe him upon it either. Wherein the fraud and the calumny of the said de Rols could not be more patently discovered.
